old: PGRs are simple molecules that act as growth promoters or inhibitors. Auxins (IAA, IBA; synthetic NAA, 2,4-D) trace to Darwin's work on canary grass phototropism and Went's isolation from oat coleoptile tips. They promote rooting, apical dominance, parthenocarpy and xylem differentiation; 2,4-D kills dicot weeds. Gibberellins (over 100 forms, GA3 most studied) were discovered by Kurosawa from Gibberella fujikuroi (bakanae disease of rice). They cause stem elongation, bolting, malting and longer grape stalks. Cytokinins, discovered as kinetin from autoclaved herring sperm DNA by Skoog and Miller, are made in roots, promote cell division and delay senescence. Ethylene, a gas found by Cousins, ripens fruit and promotes senescence. ABA, a stress hormone, closes stomata and induces dormancy.
new: PGRs are simple molecules that act as growth promoters or inhibitors. Auxins (IAA, IBA; synthetic NAA, 2,4-D) trace to Darwin's work on canary grass phototropism and Went's isolation from oat coleoptile tips. They promote rooting, apical dominance, parthenocarpy and xylem differentiation; 2,4-D kills dicot weeds. Gibberellins (over 100 forms, GA3 most studied) were discovered by Kurosawa from Gibberella fujikuroi (bakanae disease of rice). They cause stem elongation, bolting, malting and longer grape stalks. Cytokinins, discovered as kinetin from autoclaved herring sperm DNA by Skoog and Miller, are synthesised in regions of rapid cell division, e.g. root apices, developing shoot buds and young fruits, promote cell division and delay senescence. Ethylene, a gas found by Cousins, ripens fruit and promotes senescence. ABA, a stress hormone, closes stomata and induces dormancy.
